name: Simone LaRue
source:
Simone LaRue is a household name among the wine connosseurs and fashionistas of Castlecoast. Her wine bar is often crowded with Castlecoast's young elites, and her face regularly appears on lifestyle magazine covers. She is also the older sister of Marion, and is the one who influenced her interest in elemental magic.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/yangyangmobile/perfect-gold]Kickstarter[/url]]
